runtime.execution: Node host, native worker-backed JS cells, embedded agent sessions and owned process supervisors
runtime.service_boundary: Gateway owns agent/session/process policy and plugin lifetimes; consumes model, ACP, MCP and paired-node services, and can own sandbox containers

summary: A large extensible agent gateway with executable code actions, addressed session steering, configurable context engines and explicit ownership of parked continuations. These are scoped mechanisms, not a complete original audit or compiled refit protocol.

inspection.scope: Read executable cell dispatch/worker/owner cleanup, exposed file/process actions, session spawning and busy-target delivery, context-engine request assembly, transcript branching/compaction and bounded history/search diagnostics; inspect continuation and compaction tests.
inspection.limits: No reference execution. This is a bounded trace of a very large pinned tree; not all channels, sandbox/remote backends, plugins, database retention or restart transactions were traced. No assumed feature credit from adjacent products or archived instructions.

actions.name: read/list/edit/write/apply_patch
actions.input: path, range or patch under selected workspace
actions.output: bounded file content, edits or errors
actions.lifecycle: ordinary tool execution; host or sandbox bridge
actions.authority: model/program subject to standing effective workspace and read-only policy

actions.name: exec + process follow-up
actions.input: command/env/workdir/PTY/yield; session ID and poll/log/input/kill action
actions.output: exit outcome or live process handle; later output/input/termination request
actions.lifecycle: background keeps supervisor owner after tool observer ends; final settlement callback precedes notification
actions.authority: model/program permitted process scope; borrowed policy does not borrow ownership

actions.name: code-mode exec/wait
actions.input: JS source; executor and bounded catalog/namespace config; parked run handle
actions.output: incremental output, final JSON or waiting continuation and saved-result descriptors
actions.lifecycle: fresh namespace per new exec, same live cell across waits; close joins/disposes and retains failed cleanup
actions.authority: model executes enabled nested tools under ordinary policy/approvals

actions.name: results.save/load/delete
actions.input: JSON value or scoped result ID
actions.output: full stored JSON or bounded descriptor/error
actions.lifecycle: run/catalog lifetime, 64 entry and byte cap; abort/restriction clears store
actions.authority: same admitted run/catalog; old cell cannot adopt replacement store

actions.name: sessions_spawn
actions.output: accepted child identity or explicit forbidden/error
actions.lifecycle: ACP or embedded session launched with captured parent identity; acceptance is not completion
actions.authority: model under configured spawn and inherited capability boundary

actions.name: sessions_send steer/notify/followup
actions.input: target session incarnation, addressed text and delivery mode
actions.output: queued notification or accepted/steered run identity; later settlement distinct
actions.lifecycle: notify does not start run; active steer has receiver custody; absent active steer errors
actions.authority: model/operator under session visibility and exact caller/target mutation authority

actions.name: sessions_history + sessions_search
actions.input: visible session, original message anchor, paging/includeTools or query
actions.output: bounded/redacted history, snippets/IDs, indexing/excluded archive warnings
actions.lifecycle: gateway query with captured session access; not complete wire audit

actions.name: context engine assemble
actions.output: selected messages, prompt authority and system addition
actions.lifecycle: actual request path adopts selection; exception falls back to pipeline
actions.authority: host configured extension; not proven arbitrary model-installed turn loop

actions.name: plugin/channel refresh
actions.input: pending plugin refresh or channel reload generation
actions.lifecycle: cell lease prevents premature plugin release; channel lease/timeout escape can reload while other work remains

filesystem.detail: Exposed host/sandbox read/list/edit/write/patch tools; writes depend on effective workspace policy.

processes.detail: Exec yields owned process handles; process follow-up supports inspection/input/termination request. Background effects outlive a completed tool observer deliberately.

code_actions.detail: Model JS composes discovered tools and parallel calls with exec/wait; Node or plugin executors own parked continuation and bridge calls.

persistent_kernel.detail: A single parked JS cell preserves its live context across waits, but a new exec creates a fresh namespace; no serialized VM image or shared persistent computational kernel established.

standing_database.detail: Bounded JSON result references and scoped transcript query/search are actual structured state, but do not establish a writable shared research SQL database.

workflow_programming.detail: Executable JS can compose tools/conditional discovery and child work; conditional swarm surface is advertised. Durable arbitrary workflow replay was not traced.

multi_model.detail: Spawn accepts and forwards child model/thinking overrides alongside isolated/fork context and agent identity.

live_collaboration.detail: Addressed active-session steering has incarnation checks, original-input recording and receiver-owned accepted-message custody; notification and new-turn/spawn admission are separate operations.

concurrent_work.detail: Owned background programs, independently spawned sessions and concurrent bridged code calls have handles and settlement paths. No universal external-effect quiescence claimed.

steering_interrupt.detail: Busy-target steering acceptance and later input settlement are distinct. Code-action close joins its retained continuation; process kill acknowledges only termination request and background exec survives observer abort.

turn_redefinition.detail: Configured context engine participates in actual model request construction and can replace active messages/add system material with explicit budget/read fence. This is a host extension surface, not proven unrestricted model runtime reprogramming.

compaction.detail: Separate compaction/branch events survive store reload and produce a projected context; rewrite stages side entries with retained ancestry. Test oracle validates these exact persistence/projection edges.

context_repair.detail: Original message anchors, scoped history/search and transcript ancestry provide repair ingredients. Tool presentation is redacted/bounded and universal retrieval of all precompaction originals was not traced.

original_audit.detail: Transcript lineage/compaction records and process settlement exist. Optional provider diagnostics are Anthropic-only and redacted; code output/results and history are bounded. This is not retention of all original provider/program/failure IO.

audit_query.detail: sessions_history and sessions_search expose scoped transcript retrieval, anchors, tools option and indexing state; search is user/assistant snippets, history redacted/clipped, not original wire corpus.

hot_change.detail: Code-mode owners hold plugin refresh until physical continuation cleanup succeeds. Channel reload has explicit proceed-while-active escape paths, not a universal settled-turn activation rule.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Transcript ancestry/branch restore and reload ownership are useful. Live cell has no serializable VM image; channel reload may proceed active. No outpost-auth/chat executable rebuild and re-inhabitation protocol traced.

remote_services.detail: Actual ACP child dispatch and remote-workspace skill read bridge consume independent services; conditional code-mode MCP/nodes guidance is separately marked as advertised. Remote cancellation/reconnect guarantees were not traced.

self_improvement.detail: self_improvement: not established beyond the inspected code-mode, embedded context, session-tool and process lifecycles; this is not a universal absence claim.

complaints.detail: complaints: not established beyond the inspected code-mode, embedded context, session-tool and process lifecycles; this is not a universal absence claim.

authority.detail: Workspace/read-only and exec policy apply to native/nested code actions; process scopes distinguish borrowed policy from ownership. Ordinary model edits are available under standing policy; full config/turn authority not inferred.

evaluation.detail: Inspected tests discriminate late cleanup, revoked dispatch and refresh release ordering, plus persisted compaction/projection; mock completion/continuation do not prove foreign process termination or semantic summary fidelity.

time_order.detail: Monotonic performance.now budgets govern cell preparation/execution; parked expiration and channel reload elapsed budgets use Date.now. Session incarnation/read fences/receiver admission distinguish causal identity from wall time.

evidence.claim: Constructs host/sandbox read/list/edit/write/patch and exec/process tools under effective workspace/read-only policy.
Exec admits process with supervisor settlement callback, returns ongoing session handle on yield; tool abort deliberately leaves background owner active and suppresses obsolete updates.
Kill returns Termination requested after supervisor cancellation admission, not confirmed physical exit.
Exit settlement preserves observed process outcome, settles task callback before notification, and retains exact owner through failure correction.
One-shot CLI scope cleanup joins both supervisor cleanup and exec finalization; borrowed policy does not transfer process ownership.
Exec captures catalog, replay identity, run owner and bounded output; uses monotonic preparation budget and retains waiting continuations.
Dispatches Node or plugin executor; resumes a retained continuation rather than serializing an arbitrary stack.
Each new exec creates a fresh node:vm context; current cell keeps pending bridge requests and a monotonic deadline.
Continuation retains its live pool; explicitly no serialized VM image. Disposal closes pool, resumed ownership transfers.
Pool owner stays in retiring set while native task close is pending or fails; plugin release aggregates failures.
Parked cell holds plugin refresh lease. Close revokes dispatch immediately, joins late executions/disposals and retains failed cleanup before releasing lease.
One timer owns expiration of parked continuations even without a subsequent caller; expiry uses wall Date.now.
JSON results live in a run/catalog-bound WeakMap store, maximum 64 entries and byte allowance; invalidation closes/clears and capacity failure is explicit.
Advertises programmatic tools/discovery, conditional swarm/MCP/nodes and results APIs; nested calls retain normal policy/approvals, output/errors are bounded, guest modules unavailable.
Model spawn arguments select child model/thinking, isolated/fork context, run/session mode and cleanup, with ACP feature/authority constraints.
Actual execution dispatches ACP or embedded subagent, inherits exact parent identity and records accepted spawn facts.
Steer requires current active incarnation; receiving runtime owns original input commit, queued acceptance returns steered run ID and unsupported commit-wait has explicit best-effort fallback.
Accepted steering transfers mutation custody to receiver until settlement, distinct from sender completion and queue admission.
Notify is process-durable queue admission, explicitly runStarted false, not a new recipient turn.
Actual request path invokes configured context engine with token/model/tool/read-fence data, adopts assembled messages and system addition; failure falls back to pipeline messages.
Transcript rewrite prepares off-store, appends side entries retaining ancestry and adopts memory at outer publication edge; no arbitrary live stack migration.
Test appends model-produced compaction and branch summary, reloads persisted store and asserts summary/branch presence and projected final message; model completion is mocked.
History tool redacts and clips text to 4000 characters, removes details/usage/cost; global returned data is capped at 80 KiB.
Exposed history operation selects current/other visible sessions, original message anchors and optional tool messages under session authority.
Search exposes user/assistant snippets and message/session identity, bounded query/hits/snippets and incomplete-index warnings.
Search executes gateway sessions.search under per-session admission, preserving incomplete indexing and excluded archive indicators.
Anthropic-only optional diagnostics save a redacted request digest/payload and selected usage/error; explicitly do not retain original secret-bearing payload.
Channel reload initially defers for active work but can proceed on lifecycle lease demand or elapsed timeout with work still active.
Controlled continuation oracle checks immediate revocation, late continuation disposal, withheld refresh until cleanup and rejected stale dispatch; not a foreign-effect process test.
Wraps reads of selected remote workspace skill paths through workspace access/skill resources, enforcing selected roots and abort checks while leaving ordinary reads local.

tests.focus: late continuation ownership, revoked dispatch and refresh release
tests.oracle: Controlled promises assert authority revoked immediately, late continuation disposed once, refresh withheld until disposal, stale execution rejected. No real foreign-effect termination oracle.

tests.focus: compaction and branch projection survive store reload
tests.oracle: SQLite-backed test asserts persisted compaction and branch summary and projected final user message; summarizer mocked, summary factual accuracy and all original wire retention not asserted.

strengths: Explicit separation of code-action observer from live continuation custody and plugin refresh.
Addressed steering distinguishes input admission, incarnation, original transcript commit and receiving owner.
Configurable context assembly and staged transcript side branches are useful projection mechanisms.
limits: New code action does not inherit a previous namespace; live continuation cannot serialize its VM.
Channel reload can proceed with active work, conflicting with strict refit quiescence.
Provider diagnostics and history surfaces redact/clip; full original audit and model state-captured complaint were not established.
arconaut_questions: Can Arconaut represent a pending tool/process owner independently from a short-lived model/tool observer while still enforcing strict refit settlement?
How do accepted, committed and consumed peer inputs survive sender completion and recipient reincarnation?
Use explicit pending generations and settled-turn activation without the proceed-active reload escape; keep shared services outside harness quiescence.
